string.text: So, what's the situation?

So far, everything seems relatively quiet. How about you, ready for the outing? Keep in mind, we'll have little time to break through, and once we do, the corridor will collapse - there'll be nowhere to resupply our gear.
I think I'm ready to go out.

Well, it's up to you. Listen, these fanatics clearly sniffed us out already, and they've blocked the road. Besides, their snipers have taken positions on the hills - going along the highway is not an option.
Alright, so what do you suggest?
We'll go through the forest, it's relatively calm there, and then we'll come out through a hole in the fence, not far from the entrance to the lab.
I think I understand everything.
So, ready to move out?

Not yet, it's not time, the radiation is still too strong. Remember, the window will appear from nine to eleven in the evening: during this time, we must manage to dash to the entrance of the laboratory. We'll move out immediately at that time, so don't wander too far.
Okay, we'll wait.

It's been years. I don't remember much. The grid. Trucks. Men with knives. Lights. Pain. I remember the pain. I remember it well. Then there was fear and hunger. Dark. Cramped. There were many of us. There was no food, we were hungry. We ate each other. I remember the door opening. It was dangerous and very bright outside... We'd go out at night, when we couldn't see. Then we'd hide. From people like you. The hunger was gone, but the fear remained. The realization that we'd never get out of here. Not everyone could take it. I guess I'm the last of my generation. The new ones have it easier than we do. They don't know about life on the outside. They don't need it. They have the Zone.
What-- Who are you? Where am I?
You pose a great threat to everyone, to the entire zone. We can't let that happen.
What are you talking about?
You have to stay here with us.
That won't do. Let me out!
You're not going anywhere...ever.
You...
You're about to meet our friend....
Don't shoot, you...
Hey, you, I think I saw you at Bright Beam.
Go away, go away, they are hunting.
Who?
The dead, they're coming, get out of here!
What, stalkers?
Go away!
